name: tsp-new-dashboard
description: tdxTSP 涨跌停时间轴 → TSP 独立扩展页「新看板」打包源。构建依赖复用同机 tdxTSP/frontend/node_modules（软链），不在本目录安装。

scripts.deploy:
vite build && cp dist/bundle.js ../../../data-local/ext_pages/new_dashboard/bundle.js && python3 - <<'PY'
import hashlib,json,pathlib
b=pathlib.Path('../../../data-local/ext_pages/new_dashboard/bundle.js')
p=b.parent/'page.json'
d=json.loads(p.read_text())
d['size']=b.stat().st_size
d['sha256']=hashlib.sha256(b.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
p.write_text(json.dumps(d,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n')
print(d)
PY
